digest_method.file: SHA-256 over the unmodified file bytes
digest_method.category_tree: SHA-256 over UTF-8 lines '<file_sha256>  <root-relative-path>\n', sorted by root-relative path
digest_method.source_tree: The category-tree algorithm applied to all 185 regular files below installed_root

Keep provenance at section or data-record granularity when mixed-license content is decomposed.
